name: DropTheHassle
description: Your AI publishes your site live on a free HTTPS link without an email first and returns the live link plus a claim link. Right after, it can get a .com for €19/$19 a year that goes live with no DNS after the human pays a link, and an optional mailbox on the domain that sends and receives. Also checks domain availability and prices. Edit files changes one file without a rebuild, and Restore undoes the last Update or Edit files save. Collect leads turns on a contact form on a claimed site; messages land in your mailbox. An optional password locks a claimed site until you're ready; an empty password means public. Hide from Google asks search engines to skip a claimed site; visitors can still open it. No tool spends money; purchases return a payment link for the human. deploy_site and search_domain work without an account or email; account tools need a DropTheHassle token as a Bearer header.
author: DropTheHassle
